title: Repair cafés
bodyMd:
A council recorded workshop registrations and completed repairs over one month. Each registration concerns one item, and an item can be repaired at most once.

| Category | Registered items | Completed repairs |
|---|---:|---:|
| North | 60 | 42 |
| East | 80 | 48 |
| West | 100 | 80 |
